name: Novice Elreth
summary: Inside Deathknell's chapel, Novice Elreth guides the newly risen Forsaken. She sends them against the mindless Scourge near the graves and helps them face the plague's sorrowful aftermath.

sections.title: A Guide in the Church of the Damned
sections.body: Novice Elreth guides newly risen undead inside the desecrated chapel at Deathknell. They struggle to understand their horrific awakening, while the Forsaken must organize quickly to secure their territory. Elreth sends them south to gather paws from wolves and wings from bats. She also points them toward Lordaeron's tragic aftermath, including the sorrow of her friend Marla Fipps, whom her husband Samuel killed after joining the mindless Scourge.

faq.answer: Novice Elreth is inside the chapel at Deathknell, a ruined village in Tirisfal Glades where newly created Forsaken awaken.

faq.q: What is Novice Elreth's role in Deathknell?
faq.answer: Novice Elreth guides newly arisen Forsaken and gives them their first directives. She teaches them to strike against the mindless Scourge prowling the village cemetery.

faq.q: What quests does Novice Elreth offer?
faq.answer: Novice Elreth sends adventurers to gather scavenger paws and duskbat wings, and to defeat the mindless Samuel Fipps and bury his remains beside his wife Marla's grave.
Her title and place in the chapel suggest Novice Elreth is an initiate in the Forsaken's religious or civic ranks. She is learning to manage Tirisfal's freshly raised undead under the Forsaken order.

angles.text: As a newly risen Forsaken, you can take some of your first practical steps toward survival with Novice Elreth. She directs your cold hatred toward the mindless Scourge.
As a priest, you meet Novice Elreth in Lordaeron's former holy grounds. Her work shows the grim, practical needs of the undead.
